# credential for

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:credentialFor`](gmeow-credentialFor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/credentialFor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The skill or occupation that a credential certifies. Non-functional — a credential may certify several skills or both a skill and an occupation. [`Profile`](../classes/gmeow-Profile.md) compliance: the union range ([`Skill`](../classes/gmeow-Skill.md)|[`Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md)) is enforced by SHACL (shapes/expertise-shapes.ttl), not OWL, because [owl:unionOf](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#unionOf) in [rdfs:range](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#range) violates OWL 2 RL/EL.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Credential`](../classes/gmeow-Credential.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:credentialFor`](gmeow-credentialFor.md) from [`gmeow:Credential`](../classes/gmeow-Credential.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name what a credential certifies — a [`gmeow:Skill`](../classes/gmeow-Skill.md), a [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md), or both — when relating the qualification to its subject matter.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the issuer ([`gmeow:credentialIssuer`](gmeow-credentialIssuer.md)) or the holder ([`gmeow:holdsCredential`](gmeow-holdsCredential.md)); and do not rely on an OWL range to type the value — the [`Skill`](../classes/gmeow-Skill.md)|[`Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md) union is a SHACL shape (shapes/expertise-shapes.ttl), so a bad target is caught there, not by the reasoner.

### How to use

- Point the credential at one or more [`gmeow:Skill`](../classes/gmeow-Skill.md) or [`gmeow:Occupation`](../classes/gmeow-Occupation.md) targets; it is non-functional, so a credential certifying several skills lists them all, and the SHACL shape enforces the union range.
